findings.pages: D033, D148 (Twin) · D065, D195 (Rival) · D104, D161 (General) · D042, D152 (Virtuoso)
findings.quote: Twin "keep count of who gave way last", "strong-willed people". Rival "You fall for people who push back." General "You love people strong enough to push back." Virtuoso "You love the person who can answer you back."
findings.issue: Four characters at the Day Gate in Love read as one force: a partner who argues, and a calm partner who bores you. The score-keeping that the Rival's own seen line owns ("You keep score with the people closest to you") is given to the Twin.
findings.fix: **Rule:** each Day-Gate Love seat names its own force in the headline and in the "Because" sentence. "Push back", "argue back", "strong-willed" and "a calm partner bores you" go only to the Virtuoso (talk and wit). Twin: separate lives and level footing. Rival: shared stakes, money, turns and contests. General: pressure and high stakes (三命通会 论比肩/劫财/偏官; 渊海子平 六亲). **Rebuild the Twin, Rival and General Love seats (5 units each).** Samples. Twin recognition: "You fall for people who have a full life of their own, and you lose interest in anyone who needs you to lead. Because standing level is how you feel respected, you keep your own friends, money and plans inside the relationship. You find it harder to be carried by a partner, even for a day, than to carry yourself." Rival headline: "Your love runs on sharing, and on keeping count." Rival recognition: "You love by sharing, the money and the plans and the friends, and you notice who gets the bigger part. Because a partner is also the person you measure yourself against, small questions of turn and share become contests. You give generously in love, and you keep a quiet count of what comes back." General headline: "You love hardest when something is at stake."

findings.quote: Family ahead: "Your house becomes the place your family gathers" (Artisan), "your home becomes the steady centre of your family, the place relatives turn to" (Magistrate), "the steady point for your whole family …, the place relatives come to" (Steward), "the place your wider family gathers" (Sage). Love: "people who turned up on time and kept their word" (Steward), "people who keep their word" (Magistrate), "the partner who turns up on time" (Sage). "the warmth goes quiet" appears in both the Steward and the Magistrate seat cards. Health: "Your body does well when home is calm." · "Your body follows the mood of your home." · "Your body carries whatever strain your home holds." Lived: "steady in the good years and low in the strained ones" (Artisan) and "steady in the calm years and worn in the difficult ones" (Sage).
findings.issue: At the Day Gate the gate's life area writes the beat and the character only colours it. Four characters share one Family beat, three share one Love beat and three share one Health beat.
findings.fix: **Rule:** a Day-Gate beat's cause sentence must be the character's own mechanism: Artisan appetite and hosting, Magistrate the household's word and its roles, Steward provision and accounts, Sage being looked after, General pressure. Keep "the place your family gathers" for the Artisan only. Samples. Magistrate Family ahead: "From your mid-thirties you speak for your household, the one who signs, decides and keeps the family's word. You add more warmth to its order in these years, and you find your own house easier to live in than it used to be." Steward Family ahead: "From your mid-thirties your household runs on what you put by, the savings and the repairs and the bills paid early. You give these years to keeping it in order, and that order outlasts every lean spell that passes through." Sage Family ahead: "From your mid-thirties your home becomes a shelter that works both ways, and a partner looks after you as closely as you look after them. You hold the household together in these years, and you speak up more than you used to." Steward Love recognition: "You show love through provision, a full cupboard or a bill paid before your partner sees it. Because a well-kept home is how you feel loved, you judge a partner by how they handle shared money and chores. You let romance fade when the accounts fill every evening." Artisan Health recognition: "Your body runs on appetite and rest, and both are best when home is easy. Because pleasure is how you recover, a shared meal and a long sleep put you right faster than any routine. You eat and sleep worst in the weeks when nobody at home is enjoying anything."

findings.quote: "easier to fix a problem than to say a tender thing" (General), "more at ease arranging things for people than talking about feelings" (Magistrate), "you say almost nothing about what you have arranged" (Steward). Ahead beats: "find the kind thing easier to say out loud" (General), "learn in these years to say some of your care out loud" (Steward), "saying out loud some of what your money already says" (Steward), "You praise more freely" (Magistrate), "You soften with them" (General). Hour stem lived: "a sharp word from you stayed with them for years" (General) and "a word of your approval stayed with one of them for years" (Magistrate). Twin, Rival and Virtuoso: "equals who stand beside you and argue back", "the ones who push back", "the ones who stand up to you".
findings.issue: In Family at the Hour Gate, five characters share "care shown by arranging, not by words", and six ahead beats resolve it the same way ("you learn to say it out loud"). The General and the Magistrate at the Hour stem are the same parent: standards, withheld praise, one word that stayed for years. The Twin, Rival and Virtuoso share "the young who argue back".
findings.fix: **Rule:** "care by doing, not saying" belongs to the Steward (provision). The General is protection under pressure, the Magistrate the family's word and its formal roles, the Twin independence, the Rival sharing and backing, the Virtuoso talk. The "you learn to say it out loud" arc is allowed on one ahead beat, not six. Samples. Magistrate Hour-branch Family recognition: "You look after your family by keeping its word, the promise honoured and the duty done on time. Because a role is how you know your place, you take the formal jobs in the family that others avoid. Your family relies on your word, and you hold it more carefully than your feelings." General Hour-stem Family recognition: "You protect your family by making them strong, the hard lesson given early and the risk faced together. Because you trust pressure to build people, you push the young ones harder than strangers and stand closest to them in a crisis. Your family feels safe with you in a storm, and you find calm days with them harder." General Hour-stem Family lived: "The people after you have turned to you in their hardest weeks since your late forties. You pushed them to face what scared them, and you saw them come through tougher than they expected."

findings.pages: D091, D105 (Horizon month stem) · D072, D105 (Rival month branch) · D080, D072 (Horizon year stem) · D118, D114 (Rival year stem) · D135, D172, D194 (Horizon hour stem) · D151 (Rival hour stem)
findings.quote: "Your money arrives in windfalls and leaves through friends." (Horizon) and "Your money comes in bursts, and leaves with friends." (Rival). On D105, back to back: "Good years and thin ones … More than once you have spent a windfall on friends" (Horizon) and "a good year followed by a thin one. More than once you lent or spent a windfall on friends" (Rival). Year stem cards: "money moved freely in the house" and "a bold family where money moved fast". Hour stem: "you give generously and write down too little" and "you give with an open hand … give without counting".
findings.issue: In Wealth the Horizon (偏财: fluid money, windfalls, range) and the Rival (劫财: money lost to peers) carry the same beat, windfalls that leave through friends, at three gates. D105 prints the two near-identical beats one after the other.
findings.fix: **Rule:** Horizon money arrives through openings and timing and leaves into the next chance. Rival money is shared with peers, spent keeping level and lost in contests (渊海子平 论偏财 "慷慨"; 三命通会 论劫财 "破耗"). Rewrite the Rival side. Rival month-branch Wealth headline: "You spend to keep level with your friends." Rival month-branch Wealth lived: "Your income since your late teens has gone where your friends went, the round you matched and the venture you joined to keep up. You lent to the same people you competed with, and you knew who owed you to the week." Give the Rival year-stem card the same turn: money spent to match the people around you, not money that "moved fast".

findings.quote: "The Twin stands close to your Steward, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals." On B027, B053 and B133 it is followed by "Outside pressure protects it, a boss or a rule or a deadline".
findings.issue: The state reads the peers as the breaker of a wealth structure even when the Day Master is weak. 12 of the 13 pages are Underfueled. Classically, peers on a weak wealth chart carry the money (财多身弱 is eased by 比劫 and 印: 子平真诠 论财; 滴天髓 任注 "财旺身弱，用比劫"; 三命通会 "财多身弱，富屋贫人"). Naming the officer as the rescue adds more pressure to a weak core.
findings.fix: In `chartDepth.structureOf` (fam === 'wealth'), when strong === false, read 比劫 as the help. The state becomes formed, or strained by 财多 with the rescue from seal or peers, never officer. Keep strained.peers and the officer rescue for strong charts. Re-run `qa/state.mjs` and add a golden case.

findings.pages: B026, B044, B052, B074, B085, B096, B101, B104, B113 (formed.peers + the pairing) · 28 Underfueled pages carry the pairing
findings.quote: STATE: "a rule or contract keeps each share in place … you come out with your part intact." PAIRING on the same page: "you lose most where you share most, with friends and family and partners."
findings.issue: `depthResolve` prints a pairing whenever both sides are present. Strength and checks are never consulted, so 比劫夺财 says "you lose most" on all 9 pages where the STATE has just said an officer holds the peers in check (子平真诠 论财: 财格 with 比劫 is formed when 官 is present to check them). It also fires on 28 weak charts, where peers carry the money (see X-005). The pairing text itself is golden.
findings.fix: Gate 比劫夺财 on a strong chart with no officer check. Otherwise suppress it, or print a "checked" line in the voice of the golden domain line ("you also find your safety net among those same people"). Check 枭神夺食 the same way: it fires on 10 Underfueled pages, where the Alchemist is wanted.

findings.quote: STATE "The Alchemist crowds out the Artisan, and what you mean to make stays unmade while you study it." PAIRING "you study a thing so long that the moment to make it passes." STATE "you lose roles over what you say to the people above you." PAIRING "Your talent argues with whoever is in charge".
findings.issue: When the STATE's breaker is itself a pairing, Blueprint part 1 and part 4 say the same tension twice on the page. D1 asks part 4 to hold the tensions without repeating part 1.
findings.fix: **Rule:** when the STATE breaker is the pairing, part 4 prints the pairing label with no line, or a consequence line the STATE does not use. Apply in `depthResolve` by comparing `s.breaker` against the pattern's sides.

findings.pages: Missing lines: 114 of 138 Blueprint pages show two or more, and 80 show three or more. Season needs: 86 pages show two or more.
findings.quote: 10 of 10 missing lines turn on "and nobody inside it …" ("nobody inside it shelters you", "nobody inside it stands level with you", "no one in it fights you"). 30 of 30 need lines carry "your season asks for". B001 prints the frame four times in a row.
findings.issue: Blueprint part 2 prints one line per absent or needed character, and every line shares one spine. A reader meets "nobody inside it" three or four times on a typical page, and "your season asks for" two to five times.
findings.fix: **Rule:** the label already carries "no Sage" and "first need · 甲, the Alchemist", so the line starts on the reader. Drop "nobody inside it" from at least seven of the ten missing lines and "your season asks for" from all need lines. Sample, Sage missing: "Without a Sage you learned early to reassure yourself and to praise your own effort. You trust help more when you did not have to ask for it."

findings.pages: Every Advisor Domains page with two or more decades. D001 prints seven period frames and four "this year".
findings.quote: "in those years" ×46, "in these years" ×44, "in these ten years" ×14, "those years" ×7, "during those years" ×3, "through these years" ×2. 116 of 120 decade lines, 30 of 30 year lines ("this year") and 80 ahead beats carry the frame.
findings.issue: The label already gives the decade and the year, but nearly every line restates its period, so the By-decade block reads as one sentence frame repeated. Golden decade units carry the frame too, so this is a composition rule, not a rewrite of ruled text.
findings.fix: **Rule:** a decade line opens on the force ("Unusual knowledge brings you work, …"), and at most one line in three on a page carries a period phrase. Rewrite the non-golden decade lines to vary it. The year lines are owner-ruled (Y2) and stay.

findings.pages: All pages. The page checks show the "and you" joint 18 times on D001 and 19 times on B001.
findings.quote: 596 of 1,103 units (54%) end on ", and you …". "More than once" appears in 31 units and "at least once" in 21, nearly all in lived beats.
findings.issue: The voice law puts the reader as the subject of the last sentence, and writers meet it by bolting ", and you …" onto the close. On a page of 20 units the close is predictable.
findings.fix: **Rule:** at most one ", and you" close in three units on a composed page. Other closes: a sentence that starts on "You …", a "Because …" turn, or a flat cost. Cap "more than once" and "at least once" at one per page.

findings.pages: B001, B017, B046 … (Horizon 9) · B055, B074 … (Magistrate 5) · B004, B027 … (Sage 7) · B032, B058 … (Steward 9) · B006 (Twin) · B010, B016 … (General 7)
findings.quote: "you stumble on your chances late", "take on a formal role late", "meet the right teacher late", "learn to keep money late", "find your feet late", "you go untested for years"
findings.issue: "Hidden deep" is the stem's depth in a branch (余气: faint, 子平真诠 论用神), not its age. Six of ten hidden lines turn depth into lateness, which the chart does not say and which contradicts a Year-Gate seat when the hidden stem sits in the Year branch. On pages with two hidden needs, "late" also repeats.
findings.fix: Write each as a condition, the way the Alchemist and Rival lines already do. These keep the current opening; if X-008's rule is adopted, the "your season asks for" frame drops too. Horizon: "Your season asks for the Horizon and your chart keeps only a thin seam of it, and you find your chances through a friend of a friend more than through your own search." Magistrate: "Your chart buries the Magistrate your season asks for in one deep corner, and you take on formal roles reluctantly and grow into them slowly." Sage: "What your season asks for is the Sage and your chart holds it only deep down, and you lean on a teacher only once teaching yourself has run out." Steward: "You hold the Steward your season asks for only deep inside your chart, and you keep careful accounts only when something you want depends on them." Twin: "The Twin your season asks for rests deep in your chart, and you stand on your own only when nobody else is there to lean on." General: "The General your season asks for sleeps under everything else, and you rise to a hard test only when it is put directly in front of you."

findings.quote: "You turn what you know into notes or lessons for the people after you, and they come back to them for years."
findings.issue: The lived beat for the same seat and years says "you have shared less of what you found than people would like". The two poles of one seat disagree on what it does, and the ahead beat reads as the Sage.
findings.fix: "Study and quiet work of your own choosing fill your days from your late forties, and you take each question as far as it will go. You share the answers with one or two of the people after you, and you keep the rest for yourself."

findings.pages: D025, D068, D092, D138 (ahead) · D167 (lived) · seat card on 13 pages
findings.quote: "You put what you learn into a form others can use, a written method or a body of work, and you see it travel further than you do."
findings.issue: The lived beat says "you have said less about it than it deserves", and the seat card beside it says "your method stays unwritten for longer than it should". This is also the Sage's ahead beat ("a course or a set of notes or a body of advice").
findings.fix: "You grow from your late forties by mastering one rare thing completely. You go further into it than anyone around you, and you keep your method in your head long after others ask you to write it down."

findings.quote: "the serious decisions others are glad to hand over … you are consulted long after others have stopped being asked"
findings.issue: This is the Magistrate's Hour-stem Career beat ("you are trusted with decisions others will not make"): judgement and consultation, not pressure.
findings.fix: "From your late forties the work people bring you is the hardest they have, the crisis and the deadline nobody else will face. You stay in the thick of it longer than most, and you are called in long after others have stopped being asked."

findings.pages: D173 (recognition) · seat card on D130, D131, D132, D140, D173, D175, D176, D198
findings.quote: "Because you are used to being the one who gives, you wave off help you need, and it hurts the people offering."
findings.issue: The Sage is shelter and being looked after, but this beat (with its lived beat and card: "for most of your life you have done the looking after") claims a lifelong-giver biography the chart cannot know. It contradicts a Year-Gate Sage on the same chart ("You were truly looked after as a child"). It also carries a pain word.
findings.fix: "Younger people look after you more than you expected, with visits and help and small kindnesses. Because being cared for is what lets you rest, you settle into their care and stop running everything yourself. What you want from your family now is company as much as help, and you say so."

findings.quote: "Younger people bring you their hardest questions … you feel most yourself when a question has no easy answer."
findings.issue: Hard questions with no easy answer are the Alchemist's mark (its Hour-stem Career beat says "the questions their own teachers could not answer"). The Sage teaches and shelters.
findings.fix: "Younger people bring you their questions from your late forties, and you enjoy the work of teaching them properly. You are quoted and asked for in these years, and you feel most yourself when someone leaves understanding more than they came with."

findings.pages: 24 Blueprint pages, e.g. B001, B003, B005 · D111
findings.quote: "you are at your sharpest where nobody signs off on every line" · "you do your brightest work wherever the rules are loosest"
findings.issue: 伤官见官 is the classic harmful pairing ("伤官见官，为祸百端", 渊海子平; 子平真诠 论伤官). Both lines turn it into a compliment and name no cost, while the STATE notes for the same pairing name one.
findings.fix: Blueprint line: "Your talent argues with whoever is in charge, and you lose ground with the people above you over what you say. You do your best work where results count for more than rank." Career line: "You also keep correcting the very structures you climb, and it costs you favour with the people who promote you. You do your brightest work wherever the rules are loosest." (With X-007's rule, the line drops where the STATE already names this.)

findings.quote: "The Twin stands close to your Steward, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals." Filled on pages as "your Stewards", "your Horizons", "The Rival and the Twin stand close to your Stewards". "You work hard for gains that slip away, and you tire of the upkeep before you enjoy the reward."
findings.issue: On 17 pages the strain is the last word: there is no WHAT PROTECTS IT line, and neither note says what carries the reader. The peers slot also pluralises a character into "your Stewards" and "your Horizons".
findings.fix: Engine: fill {wealth} in the singular ("your Steward"). Peers note: "{peers} stand close to your {wealth}, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals. You keep the most where your own share is written down before anyone asks." None note: "Money and the duties that come with it arrive faster than you can hold them. You work hard for gains that slip away, and you keep what stays through the people who back you."

findings.quote: "you came out of it with work that still feels like the most important you have done"
findings.issue: The heavy decade names almost no cost and closes on a triumph, so it reads as the helping line ("Your thinking grew original, and you trusted hunches that later proved right").
findings.fix: "You turned inward in those years, into subjects few people around you shared, and work you owed others waited. You spent long stretches alone with your thinking, and what carried you was the one idea you saw through to the end."

findings.quote: "You keep learning what few people bother to learn." · "you grow faster on your own than in any class, and you find most courses too slow"
findings.issue: Growth is becoming more yourself, and this seat reads as Mind (learning, classes, courses). 47 of 93 Growth units lean on learning, skill or study words. This seat is the clearest case.
findings.fix: Headline: "You become more yourself the further you go from the crowd." Recognition: "With each decade you become more of the odd one, and you stop apologising for it. Because the unusual is where you feel most yourself, you drop the roles and habits that were only for show. You buy the out-of-print book and write to the one person still working on the question."

findings.quote: "you catch yourself repeating it and correct it"
findings.issue: Harm (六害) is a quiet irritation, and repetition is punish or self-punish. This line is near the year–hour self-punish line ("Your childhood plays out again around the young ones in your care").
findings.fix: "Something small from your own childhood rubs at how you treat the young ones in your care, a tone or a rule you never chose. You notice the irritation in yourself and smooth it over before it grows."

findings.quote: "You meet each problem with the answer it calls for, not with a fixed order."
findings.issue: The close is opaque and turns on "not with". It also tells the reader nothing about the season's 壬 then 戊 (which the reading gets right).
findings.fix: "Metal first comes alive in early summer, and the heat around you warms more than it melts. A river's Water comes first to keep you cool and even, and solid Earth second to steady you with the sun beside it. You keep your shape through the heat once water and solid ground are both close."

findings.pages: Year lines: 15 and 14 Domains pages, plus the Almanac Year page, which reads both (Y1). Seen line: 33 Blueprint pages
findings.quote: "you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking"
findings.issue: The same image appears three times: in the Career year line ("you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about"), the Social year line and the seen line ("the one who says what the rest of the meeting was thinking"). The Almanac's year page prints the Career and Social lines together.
findings.fix: "Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you become the one your circle quotes the next day."

findings.quote: "Even so, you learn well inside a frame …"
findings.issue: "Even so" concedes against a line that is not there. On D059, D085 and D198 the line before it makes no contrary claim, and on D059 it says the same thing ("you learn easily inside a course or a school").
findings.fix: "You also learn well inside a frame like a school or a discipline, and you keep studying long after the course has ended."

findings.quote: "Through your Home Chapter your closest friendships have been …"
findings.issue: Day lived beats also run as "the pattern so far" for readers under 35, before the Home Chapter has begun.
findings.fix: "So far your closest friendships have been between equals, people who did not need you to rescue them. You gave less time to the friends who wanted looking after, and you kept the level ones."

findings.quote: "the half it cannot do without"
findings.issue: Broken idiom for 乏丁无用 (without 丁 the cut is useless).
findings.fix: "Winter's last month is the coldest stretch of your year, and your Wood sits frozen with no sign of growth. The season asks for Metal first to split you open and then for Fire to catch in the opened grain, the one thing it cannot do without. You shine in the deep cold the moment that flame takes hold."

findings.quote: "often away from"
findings.issue: Banned hedge.
findings.fix: "You grew in those years by going your own way, away from what was expected of you. The progress was real and nearly invisible, and you kept going on your own conviction while you felt behind."

findings.quote: "often an adult who lived in their own head"
findings.issue: Banned hedge.
findings.fix: "In your first home someone gave you books, questions or long silences in place of the usual fuss, an adult who lived in their own head. By your teens you had learned to answer your own questions, and you asked for help less than other children did."

findings.quote: "often before you ask for it"
findings.issue: Banned hedge.
findings.fix: "You end up in charge in most places you work, before you have asked for it. Because pressure has been familiar since your first years, you take on serious work that makes others nervous. You rise through hard roles, and you find easy ones dull within months."

findings.quote: "and sometimes have to defend"
findings.issue: Banned hedge.
findings.fix: "The Rival lives inside your Hour Gate: what you build in later life you will share, and you will defend your part of it. Your later life stays loud and full, with children or younger relatives or someone you train arguing with you and for you. Because you value being matched more than being obeyed, you are drawn to the bold ones, and you give them more than you promised yourself. You share most of what you build late, and you hold on to your part only where you fixed its size early."

findings.quote: "a lucky move"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a well-timed move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay."

findings.quote: "a lucky move"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "Openings came your way in those years, a timely move or a chance offer or someone who knew someone. Money reached you by routes regular pay never took, and you grew bolder with it."

findings.quote: "how your own luck runs"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "What you have earned since your late teens has followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. At least once you have lost the gains of a good year by chasing a better one, and you have learned how your own streaks run."

findings.quote: "each lucky stretch"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "You earn in bursts, a run of good months and a quiet stretch after. Because each good season makes you sure of the next, you spend the winnings on a new chance before you have kept any. You are richer in the middle of each good stretch than after it."

findings.quote: "Your luck with money"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "Your money improves the further you go from home."

findings.quote: "through friends or luck"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "You spend quickly and generously, and money that comes in through friends or windfalls goes out the same way. Because a free hand with money was admired at home when you were young, saving feels cautious to you in a way you dislike. Your bank balance swings more than most people's, and you are calm about it until a lean month arrives."

findings.quote: "without luck or risk"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "Careful earning paid off in those years, and you saved steadily from regular work. You built up something solid without windfalls or risk, and you trusted your own counting more than any tip."

findings.quote: "mistake for luck"
findings.issue: Banned word.
findings.fix: "The Steward lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your first years lay a careful home where nothing was wasted. You took in your family's habits with money before you could name them, and they still shape how you feel about spending. Because thrift felt like safety when you were small, you save quietly and early, and your money grows in ways other people mistake for a windfall. Your relatives remain the people you turn to first, and they turn to you. Under the calm sits a small worry about running short, and you carry it even in good years."

findings.quote: "a brother, sister or cousin"
findings.issue: Gendered words.
findings.fix: "The Rival lives inside your Year Gate: in your first home almost everything was shared, and almost everything was claimed. As a child you shared a bed or a bike or a birthday with a sibling or a cousin who wanted their turn. Because nothing at home stayed yours for long, you learned to give quickly and to keep a quiet count. Your family reaches for your help and your money first, and you say yes before you have worked out what it costs."

findings.quote: "You are hurt more than most"
findings.issue: Pain word.
findings.fix: "In family life you expect warmth, and you give it back without thinking. Because care at home was steady from the start, you trust your relatives easily and find it hard to believe the worst of them. You take it harder than most when a relative lets you down, because you never expected it."

findings.quote: "The Rival stands close to your Steward, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals."
findings.issue: The engine blames peers on every chart where the classics say they are already answered or wanted: 312 of 3,000 charts get this note and all 312 have a weak Day Master (271), an officer seated (197) or output seated (269); 子平真诠 论用神成败救应 "财逢劫而透食以化之，生官以制之", 子平真诠 论财 makes the wealth structure's success conditional on 身强, and 滴天髓 (任注) reads 财多身弱 with 比劫 as the help. On B027 the rescue then names outside pressure (the officer), which drains a chart already at 3% Water.
findings.fix: Rule: (1) peers plus a seated officer or output → `formed.peers`; (2) peers on a weak Day Master with neither → `strained.none` (heavy wealth, the peers help); (3) only a strong Day Master with peers and neither officer nor output → `broken.peers`; retire `strained.peers`. For a weak wealth structure the rescue is the seal or self family, never the officer. Evidence: 312/3,000 charts, 4 of my 45 pages.

findings.quote: "The Magistrate stands over your Virtuoso, and every rule you work under becomes a quarrel."
findings.issue: B007 is 庚 born in 子 month, a 金水伤官, which the classics say wants the officer (渊海子平 伤官诀 "金水伤官要见官 … 惟有水木伤官格，财官两见始为欢"; 子平真诠 论伤官 on cold metal needing fire), and the page's own season cell asks for that Magistrate (丁) first (穷通宝鉴 十一月庚金 "丁甲"). Of 42 broken 伤官格 in the 3,000 sample, 2 are 金水 and 8 are 水木 with wealth seated: 10 of 42 are broken by an officer the verse welcomes.
findings.fix: Rule: the officer breaks a 伤官格 only for 火土 and 木火 (and 土金 while the officer stays); for 庚辛 born 亥子丑 the officer forms it, for 壬癸 with wealth seated the officer forms it. Add a formed note for these, e.g. `STRUCTURE output · status.formed.officer`: "The Magistrate over your Virtuoso gives your talent a place to land instead of a fight. You speak your mind from inside a role, and you are trusted for how sharp you are."

findings.quote: "what protects it · Virtuoso decade 2010 to 2019"
findings.issue: For a Magistrate structure mixed with the General the engine lists Virtuoso decades as the protection, but the Virtuoso is the Magistrate's own breaker (子平真诠 论正官; 伤官见官), and the remedy for a mixed 正官格 is to combine or control the General (论用神成败救应 "杂杀而合杀以清之"; 食神 制杀). 116 of 122 正官格-strained-by-General charts in the sample list a Virtuoso decade; the same page prints 伤官见官.
findings.fix: Rule: for `正官格` + `七杀`, rescue gods = `['食神']` (plus a stem that combines the General); keep `食神, 伤官` for `七杀格` + `正官` (去官留杀). M-1 also applies to this page.

findings.quote: "you come out with your part intact" (formed.peers) then "you lose most where you share most" (比劫夺财), B026, B044
findings.issue: Part 4 prints a pairing whenever both characters sit, with no regard to the STATE or to a pairing that cancels it: 食神制杀 with 枭神夺食 (B001, B002, B025, B042; 337/3,000), against 子平真诠 论用神成败救应 "食逢枭而就杀以成格，或生财以护食" and 论偏官 "七杀用食制，不要露财透印"; 伤官见官 where a seal is seated and the STATE is formed (B003, B006, B011, B032, B041; 448/3,000), against "官逢伤而透印以解之"; 枭神夺食 where wealth guards the Artisan or the seal is the cure (B036, B042, B045; 512/3,000 with wealth); 比劫夺财 beside formed.peers (B026, B044; 113/3,000); and the STATE's breaker said again as a pairing (B004, B013, B027, B033, B005, B007, B039, B019).
findings.fix: Rule, applied after the STATE: drop a pairing whose breaker the STATE already names; drop 伤官见官 when a seal is seated; drop 枭神夺食 when wealth is seated, and on a weak chart with heavy output; when 枭 and 食神 and 七杀 all sit, show 杀印相生 and not 食神制杀; never print 比劫夺财 beside `formed.peers`. 21 of 45 pages.

findings.quote: "you study in private and keep the strangest of what you learn to yourself" then "You think in strange directions and keep most of those thoughts to yourself" (B001)
findings.issue: A rooted need is a branch's main stem and a shown need is a stem on show, so the same character's need line and seen line land on one page, and the need lines are written as public or private persona lines: 59 same-character pairs on 33 pages, 29 near-verbatim (General rooted vs inside on 7 pages, Alchemist on 5, Sage shown vs plain on 4).
findings.fix: Rebuild the 30 need lines so each says the job the season gives the character (warms, cools, feeds the source, banks the water, splits the fuel, washes), keyed by that job and the state, with the character named only in the label; leave public and private to Part 3.

findings.quote: "you raise or train them by rules you wrote yourself" then "You hold the people after you to the standards you were raised on" (B006)
findings.issue: One branch pair that is both 冲 and 刑 (寅申, 丑未), both 害 and 刑 (寅巳) or both 合 and 刑 (巳申) prints two lines for the same two gates, and they contradict (B003, B006 year_hour; B021 "draws in the younger people" vs "The same argument returns at home") or say one thing twice (B001, B017); 774 of 3,000 charts. 三命通会 论刑 counts 寅申 and 丑未 inside the 三刑 sets they also clash in, and reads 巳申 as a bind carrying a punishment: one verdict per pair.
findings.fix: One line per gate pair, by precedence 冲 > 刑 > 害 > 合, or a combined unit for 合+刑 ("a tie with friction in it"). Seven of my pages.

findings.pages: B001, B007, B014, B022, B023, B025, B029, B034 (and B005, B021, B033 for "your later years")
findings.quote: "you change course in your late forties" (B001 age 20, B025 age 31, B007 age 63); "the circle you build now stays with you" (B022 age 59); "you leave home early" (B034 age 64)
findings.issue: Bond units carry no tense, so the seven that place an event at a gate read as a present-tense prediction to younger readers and as a present-tense account of the past to older ones; the brief asks lived lines in the past and coming lines in the future.
findings.fix: Key these seven units by the later gate's tense (lived / now / ahead) through `gateTense`, as the Domains seats are, e.g. `bond.clash.month_hour.ahead`: "The work of your rising years will stop fitting your later life, and you will change course rather than hold on to it." and `.lived`: "The work of your rising years stopped fitting your later life, and you changed course rather than hold on to it."

findings.quote: "The General your season asks for works unseen from within" under "Earth to hold back the water" (B001)
findings.issue: 穷通宝鉴 十月丙火 makes 壬 conditional ("木旺宜庚，水旺宜戊，火旺用壬，随宜酌用可也"), yet the table prints it as a need on a weak 丙 whose chart is half Water; 四月乙木 says "自有丙火 … 丙火酌用", yet B005 prints the Virtuoso (丙) as asked for right after "more sun than you asked for".
findings.fix: Move 丙亥 壬 to `conditional` ("火旺用壬") and 乙巳 丙 to `conditional` ("自有丙火，酌用"), rebuild with `tools/build-season-table.mjs`, and audit the other 118 cells for stems the text gives only 随宜 or 酌用.

findings.criterion: A1, D2 (missing line leans on the family)
findings.quote: "You keep what you earn without a contest"
findings.issue: The line speaks for both peers, so it contradicts 比劫夺财 or a strained wealth STATE wherever the Twin sits (364/3,000 charts).
findings.fix: "No Rival sits anywhere in your chart, and no one in it dares you to race or to win. You leave contests to other people, and you meet real competition only when a colleague wants the same post."

findings.quote: "nobody inside it stands level with you or carries half the load"
findings.issue: On Rival-structure pages the same page says "equals who compete with you" and "your circle of equals"; equals belong to both peers, the Twin's own force is self-reliance.
findings.fix: "Your chart has no Twin, and nothing inside it tells you that you can manage alone. You find your footing through other people, a team or a close friend, and you stand firmest when someone stands beside you."

findings.quote: "nobody in it lets you rest or enjoy your own work"
findings.issue: Under a Virtuoso structure whose STATE says "the work you enjoy keeps finding someone who wants it", the missing Artisan line claims the whole output family.
findings.fix: "The Artisan is missing from your chart, and nothing in it lets you rest without a reason. You plan your pleasures like tasks, a booked dinner or a day off on the calendar, and you relax best when someone else sets the table."

findings.quote: "You stand on your title and your word"
findings.issue: The note serves 七杀格 and 正官格 alike but reads as the Magistrate (title, word) on General structures, and stacks "standing … stand … footing".
findings.fix: "Duty and pressure work in your favour, and the demands placed on you come with standing attached. You take on heavy roles and hard tests, and you keep your footing where others give way."

findings.quote: "Learning and shelter hold steady around you, from teachers"
findings.issue: On an Alchemist structure the note reads as the Sage (shelter, teachers), and "around you" closes both sentences.
findings.fix: "Your learning holds steady, from study, credentials and people who vouch for you. What you know keeps you safe, and you recover from a setback faster than the people around you."

findings.quote: "Only the people you live with meet the second list."
findings.issue: The reader is not the subject, "the second list" is screen talk, and "the people you live with" assumes a household the chart cannot know.
findings.fix: "You save what sits inside for the few people who know you best."

findings.quote: "when the stakes are high and the clock runs short"
findings.issue: It repeats the General structure reading ("the stakes are real and the deadline is close") and the General plain line ("when the stakes are high") on the same pages.
findings.fix: "Pressure that rattles other people settles you, and you turn it into finished work instead of worry."

findings.quote: "you lose most where you share most"
findings.issue: A plain money loss with no carry-through, not tied to a decade or gate (Q11, D4 open door).
findings.fix: "Equals and money share your chart, and you lose most where you share most, with friends and family and partners. You keep the money that carries only your name."

findings.quote: "you argue with yourself less than most people do"
findings.issue: Branch bonds speak of family, work, home and the people after you, not inner argument, and the comparison with "most people" is a claim the chart cannot make.
findings.fix: "No clashes, punishments or harms sit between your gates, and you move between work and home without one pulling against the other."

findings.quote: "Wood alone carries three quarters of your chart" (84%, B037)
findings.issue: `shareWords` tops out at "three quarters" from 72%, so 78–84% shares are understated.
findings.fix: Code: `const shareWords = (x) => (x >= 0.8 ? 'four fifths' : x >= 0.72 ? 'three quarters' : x >= 0.6 ? 'two thirds' : x >= 0.5 ? 'more than half' : 'nearly half');` (the T1 templates stay as worded).

findings.quote: "you live mostly through what you answer to" after "you answer to it first"
findings.issue: The approved WHY templates all close on "you answer to it", so the officer noun "what you answer to" and the General structure's "Your chart answers to pressure" make "answer" the page's most repeated verb.
findings.fix: Change the slot value, not the T1 templates: `officer: 'the duties you carry'`.

findings.quote: "The Magistrate shows beside your General"
findings.issue: On B002 and B028 the Magistrate sits inside a branch (丑, 申), not on show.
findings.fix: "The Magistrate sits beside your General, and you switch between fighting for ground and asking for it politely. People above you get mixed signals, and you lose credit that one clear approach would win."

findings.quote: "a hard test … face few real tests"
findings.issue: "test" twice in two sentences.
findings.fix: "Your chart is without the General, and nobody inside it sets you a hard test or a date you cannot move. You keep your own pace with little to push against, and you learn how strong you are only when pressure comes from outside."

findings.quote: "counts what comes in … to keep the count"
findings.issue: "count" twice.
findings.fix: "Your chart gives the Steward no place, and nobody inside it keeps the books or counts what comes in. You handle money in bursts and forget it for months, and you rely on a partner or a spreadsheet to keep track."

findings.quote: "runs as a thin thread … answers run out"
findings.issue: "run" twice in one sentence.
findings.fix: "The Alchemist your season asks for lies as a thin thread far beneath the surface, and you reach for strange knowledge only when ordinary answers run out."

findings.quote: "a kitchen nobody else uses"
findings.issue: It asserts the reader lives alone.
findings.fix: "The Artisan your season asks for stays beneath the surface, and you refill yourself through a private craft or a slow meal at home."

findings.quote: "close to your Horizons"
findings.issue: The composer pluralises the character's name when it sits twice.
findings.fix: Code: `const statusUnit = fill(statusKey, { breakers: breakers.join(' and the '), stand: pl(breakers.length, 'stands', 'stand'), gods: P }, statusText);` (moot once BA-001 retires the unit).

findings.quote: "first need · 庚, the Steward" under "prizes Wood most" (B008)
findings.issue: The label counted position after absent stems drop out, so the cell's second stem read "first need" and a third read "second need" (464/3,000 charts), against the 穷通宝鉴 order the reading states. Commit d95812d (landed during this audit) ranks by `primaryOrder` and fixes B008, B021, B022, B023; the third primary still reads "second need" (B001, 十月丙火 甲戊庚).
findings.fix: Code, in the needs label: `${a.rank === 'primary' ? ['first need', 'second need', 'third need'][primaryOrder.indexOf(a.stem)] : 'support'} · ${a.stem}, the ${persona(a.god)} · ${STATE_WORD[a.state]}`

findings.quote: ", and you" ×10 to ×23 per page (mean 17); "nobody" mean 5, max 9
findings.issue: Four in five Blueprint units are built "X, and you Y", so every page repeats one joint 17 times, against C (no joint repeated).
findings.fix: Rule for the Blueprint units: at most one ", and you" per unit, varied joints ("so you", a full stop then "You", "which", "until"), and "nobody" at most once per part; apply first to the units on most pages (the missing lines, pairings, bonds); the T1 templates go back to the owner.

findings.quote: "Money pulls at your learning, and study keeps losing out to whatever pays this month." (B064, a strong 庚 with Earth at 60%) · "The Rival stands close to your Horizon, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals." (B053, an extremely weak 乙)
findings.issue: `structureOf` reads every breaker and rescue without the Day Master's strength, except for 七杀 broken and the weak-wealth flag. So a strong seal chart is told money breaks it, a weak wealth chart is told its own helpers rob it, and a weak officer chart is prescribed output that drains it further.
findings.fix: Rule: pass strength into every family check. **(a) Money on a seal structure.** It strains the structure only on an Underfueled chart. On an Overfueled chart money is the remedy (子平真诠 论印绶: 印重身强，透财以抑太过，权而用之). In 3,000 charts, 104 of the 112 money strains sit on strong charts. Here: B049, B064, B077, B079. **(b) 比劫 on a wealth structure.** It breaks the structure only on an Overfueled chart. On an Underfueled chart the peers carry the wealth (滴天髓 何知章, 任铁樵 on 财多身弱 以比劫为用), so the note should be `strained.none`, with the seal or the peers as the rescue. That is 265 of the 445 wealth charts with 比劫. Here: B053, B055, B080. With 食神 or 伤官 on a stem, the 比劫 is already turned (子平真诠 论用神成败救应: 财逢劫而透食以化之), which happens on 64 charts that now read "under strain". **(c) 官杀混杂 or an unchecked General on an Underfueled chart.** The rescue is the seal (子平真诠 论偏官 煞用印, 杀印相生), and a seated seal means the structure is already held. That is 122 of the 237 mix strains. Here: B071, B078, B082, B088. **(d) A 食神 or 伤官 structure on an Underfueled chart with no seal seated.** It should read strained, with the seal as the rescue (子平真诠 论伤官 伤官佩印). That is 99 of the 501 "formed" output charts. Here: B060, B089.

findings.pages: 枭神夺食 beside a seated Horizon or Steward: B058, B059, B066, B069, B086 · 伤官见官 beside a seated seal: B056, B071, B072, B073, B076 · 伤官见官 on a 七杀格: B046 · 比劫夺财 on Underfueled charts: B053, B055, B063, B067, B070, B080, B082, B088, B089
findings.quote: "Your thinking outweighs your making, and you study a thing so long that the moment to make it passes." printed under the STATE "What you make and say reaches people without getting stuck on the way." (B069, 食神格)
findings.issue: A pairing prints whenever both characters are seated. It still prints when the chart holds the classical cure, even where the engine uses that same cure to set the STATE, so the pairing and the STATE contradict each other on one page.
findings.fix: Rule: give TG_PATTERN a guard as well as its gods. **枭神夺食** does not fire when 偏财 or 正财 is seated (子平真诠 论用神成败救应: 食遇枭而…生财以护食). That removes 500 of 725 firings, 355 of them beside a formed STATE. **伤官见官** does not fire when a seal is seated (same chapter: 官逢伤而透印以解之), which covers 449 of 640 firings. It also does not fire on a 七杀格, where the Virtuoso on the Magistrate clears the mix (子平真诠 论偏官, 去官留煞), which covers 49. **比劫夺财** fires only on an Overfueled chart, which removes 671 of 1,720 firings. On an Underfueled chart the peers are the help: they are a catalyst in the app's own model (`decadePole`) and in 滴天髓. The Domains PATTERN step reads the same TG_PATTERNS and needs the same guard.

findings.quote: "first need · 丙, the Sage · inside a branch, not on show" (B059, 四月己: 取癸为要，次用丙火)
findings.issue: The needs are numbered after the absent stems are dropped. When 穷通宝鉴's first stem is absent, its second stem is labelled "first need", so the page states the classical order backwards.
findings.fix: Rule: number each need by its place in `SEASON_TABLE` (primary[0] is the first need and primary[1] the second, whichever are present), and set the rank before the absent stems are filtered out. This affects 442 of 3,000 charts (15%).

findings.quote: "Your own household breaks sharply from the one you grew up in" and then "Old house rules from your childhood come back inside your own home" (B052, B079, B081)
findings.issue: Four branch pairs carry two relations at once: 寅申 and 丑未 (clash and punish), 巳申 (bind and punish) and 寅巳 (harm and punish). For these the page prints two lines for one pair of gates, and the two lines repeat or contradict each other.
findings.fix: Rule: one line per pair of gates. 冲 outranks 刑, since the pair is only part of the 三刑 trio 寅巳申 or 丑戌未 (三命通会 论三刑). For 巳申, 合 outranks 刑 (合中带刑). For 寅巳, 刑 outranks 害. The punish line prints alone only when the full trio is in the chart. This affects 725 of 3,000 charts (24%): 寅巳 253, 巳申 244, 寅申 227, 丑未 209.

findings.quote: "Learning and shelter hold steady around you, from teachers, credentials and people who vouch for you." printed under "you rely on what you worked out more than on what you were taught" (B050, B058, B063, B076) · "You trade courses and mentors for earnings" (B049, B064, B079) · "You stand on your title and your word" (B087, 七杀格)
findings.issue: The state notes are keyed by family. An Alchemist structure therefore gets the Sage's teachers and mentors, and a formed General structure gets the Magistrate's title and word, so the STATE contradicts the structure reading above it.
findings.fix: Rebuild: key the notes by structure where a family splits. Add `STRUCTURE pianyin_ge · status.formed.none`, `STRUCTURE pianyin_ge · status.strained.money` and `STRUCTURE qisha_ge · status.formed.none`, plus `piancai_ge · status.formed.none` for symmetry, since the wealth note "steady return" is the Steward's. Write each one as its own character. Of the 426 formed seal charts, 189 are 偏印格, and 52 偏印格 charts carry the money strain. 子平真诠 论印绶 treats the two seals alike for the rule, so only the wording changes, not the logic.

findings.pages: 40 of 45: every page except B054, B058, B061, B067, B082
findings.quote: "you save quietly and keep more in reserve than anyone guesses", then in INSIDE "you sleep better with something put aside" (B051, B070, B086) · "you meet hard tests in public and are trusted for how you handle them", then in IN PLAIN VIEW "the person people send in when the stakes are high" (B056, B071, B073, B074, B078, B080, B087)
findings.issue: A need line describes how the character shows in public or in private. That is Part 3's job, so on most pages Part 2 says the same trait before Part 3 says it again.
findings.fix: Rule, then a rebuild of the 20 shown and rooted need lines: a need line says what holding that character does for the season's balance (the warmth, water or fuel the month lacks, in the season reading's own terms), and leaves the public and private trait to Part 3.

findings.pages: B086, and every no-hour chart (265 of 265 in 3,000)
findings.quote: "Your chart has no Twin, and nobody inside it stands level with you" (B086, no birth hour)
findings.issue: With the hour unknown, the MISSING lines assert an absence that the unread Hour pillar could fill. STRONGEST and the strength band also count the noon pillar the app puts in its place (`chartContext.resolveHourForCalc` returns 12).
findings.fix: Rule: on a no-hour chart, MISSING shows one label row ("completes once your birth time is set", as the pillar card already says) instead of the lines, and STRONGEST and the band are computed from three pillars.

findings.quote: "…, and you …" 12 to 21 times a page (B071 ×21; B062, B073, B078, B088 ×19) · "…, and nobody inside it …" in 9 of the 10 missing units (six times on B060)
findings.issue: Nearly every unit closes on the same joint, and the MISSING units share one frame, so a page reads as one sentence shape repeated 20 times.
findings.fix: Rule: at most two "…, and you …" joints per part, and no MISSING frame twice on one page. Rebuild the 10 missing lines with distinct openers, and vary the joint across the 20 seen lines and the 42 bond lines.

findings.quote: "and you argue with yourself less than most people do"
findings.issue: The bonds read the life areas of the gates (family, work, home and the people after you). No hard bond means those areas sit easily together, not that the reader argues less with themself.
findings.fix: "No clashes, punishments or harms sit between your gates, and you keep your family and your work and your home on easy terms."

findings.quote: "and the people you train along the way become your strongest allies"
findings.issue: Neither clause has the reader as its subject, which breaks the voice law.
findings.fix: "The momentum you build at work carries well into your later life, and you count the people you train along the way among your strongest allies."

findings.quote: "and what you start in your rising years keeps growing through every later decade"
findings.issue: Neither clause has the reader as its subject.
findings.fix: "Work, home and the people after you build on each other, and you keep growing what you start in your rising years through every later decade."

findings.quote: "Hour joins Year · 巳酉丑" (B072, a full frame across the Year, Month and Hour Gates)
findings.issue: A frame across three gates is labelled with its first and last gate only, so the label drops a gate that the text beneath it names.
findings.fix: Name every gate of a three-gate frame: "Year, Month and Hour join · 巳酉丑". This affects 401 of 3,000 charts.

findings.quote: "You warm slowly and hold heat a long time, and you thaw the moment the light reaches your slopes."
findings.issue: One sentence says the reader warms slowly and also thaws at once.
findings.fix: "In midwinter your mountain freezes solid, ice in every crevice and snow across the summit. The season depends on Fire alone to thaw you, with Wood as its helper to keep that fire supplied. You warm slowly once the light reaches your slopes, and you hold that heat a long time."

findings.quote: "meet the second list"
findings.issue: One meets a person, not a list, so the collocation breaks.
findings.fix: "Only the people you live with see the second list."

findings.quote: "between your partner and the people after you"
findings.issue: "Your partner" assumes the reader has one. The law, and every other bond unit, says "a partner".
findings.fix: "A quiet friction runs between a partner and the people after you, and you spend years smoothing over complaints nobody says out loud."

findings.quote: "you build on doors your parents or siblings opened"
findings.issue: The idiom is broken: one walks through a door, one does not build on it.
findings.fix: "The household you grew up in gives your working life a running start, and you walk through doors your parents or siblings opened for you."

findings.quote: "the circle you build now stays with you"
findings.issue: "Now" puts the working years in the present for readers who are past them (61, 64 and 50 on these pages).
findings.fix: "You carry the people and skills of your working years into your later life, and the circle you build in those years stays with you."

findings.quote: "the half it cannot do without"
findings.issue: "The half" makes the reader parse the sentence twice.
findings.fix: "Winter's last month is the coldest stretch of your year, and your Wood sits frozen with no sign of growth. The season asks for Metal first to split you open and then for Fire to catch in the opened grain, the one it cannot do without. You shine in the deep cold the moment that flame takes hold."

findings.quote: "Its first need is Water"
findings.issue: "Its" has no clear antecedent: it could be the freezing rain or midwinter.
findings.fix: "Freezing rain frosts you over in midwinter and hides the sun. The month's first need is Water in full flow to keep you clean and moving, and its second the sun's Fire, with Earth and Wood steadying both. You glitter in the cold once those two are close beside you."

findings.criterion: A1 (a claim the chart cannot know)
findings.quote: "You get through this season on the strength of others like you."

findings.issue: The engine names the breaker and the rescue without reading the Day Master's strength or whether the breaker shows on a stem, so the classical remedy is often reported as the fault.
findings.fix:
**Evidence (3,000 charts):** 271 of 312 `strained.peers` charts are Underfueled, and 197 of those 312 already seat an officer that checks the peers. 115 of 127 `strained.money` charts are Overfueled. 188 of 259 officer charts given the output rescue are Underfueled, and 137 of those 188 already seat a seal. 140 `wealth · strained.none` charts get no protector line. 162 of 390 breakers (42%) sit only as a branch's main stem.

**Classical basis:** 子平真诠 论用神成败救应: "财逢劫而透官，此因败而得成者也", so a seated officer already rescues the wealth. 渊海子平: "财多身弱，富屋贫人"; 任注滴天髓: 喜比劫帮身. 子平真诠 论印绶: "有印多而用财者，印重身强，透财以抑太过，权而用之". 子平真诠 论偏官: a weak self under 杀 is protected by the seal (杀印相生), not by more output. 伤官见官 and 官杀混杂 are judged on the revealed stems (透干).

**Rule:** (1) A wealth structure on an Underfueled chart treats 比劫 as help. If an officer is seated, the key is `status.strained.none`, and the rescue is self or seal, which needs new `rescue.self*` units. (2) A seal structure on an Overfueled chart with the seal heavy treats wealth as the cure (`status.formed.none`). (3) An officer structure on an Underfueled chart gets the seal rescue, and none when a seal is already seated. (4) A breaker must show on a stem, or carry a 0.6 root with a stem of its family, before it can break or strain.
